insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
plan_name: Star Micro Rural And Farmers Care

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen

icu.note: ICU charges covered under general hospitalisation expenses; no separate ICU sub-limit stated in policy wording

copayment.note: 20% co-payment on every admissible claim for insured persons aged 61 or above at first entry; waived for those who entered before 61 and renew continuously

sub_limits.note: Cataract limited to ₹10,000 per eye and ₹15,000 per policy period; modern treatments (robotic surgery, deep brain stimulation, etc.) capped at ₹25,000–₹50,000 per procedure per SI slab; stents limited to bare metal/drug-eluting cobalt-chromium/stainless steel cost; medicines/implants limited to indigenous make cost

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable after 12 months of continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 6 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception with insurer

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacement, gallbladder, kidney calculi, varicose veins, transplants, etc.) excluded for 6 months; waived for accidents

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under Code Excl 18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses not explicitly mentioned as a separate benefit in the policy wording

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses not explicitly mentioned as a separate benefit in the policy wording

day_care.note: Policy explicitly states all day care procedures are covered

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary treatment benefit mentioned in the policy wording

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to sum insured; Yoga and Naturopathy require prior company approval

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses not mentioned; all types of transplant and related surgeries are listed as a specific disease waiting period exclusion for 6 months

ambulance.note: Ambulance cover not mentioned in the policy wording

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered but with per-procedure caps ranging ₹5,000–₹50,000 depending on SI slab; Bronchial Thermoplasty and Stem cell therapy for haematological conditions covered up to SI

consumables.note: Consumables/non-medical items are subsumed into room/procedure charges per the listed schedule; no separate consumables cover or rider offered

global_cover.note: Territorial limit explicitly restricts all treatments to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes; coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Cochlear implants, EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2 therapy, circumcision, congenital external defects, all transplants (6mo wait), biologicals (outpatient)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-on covers described in the policy wording
